     1→'use client';
     2→
     3→import React from 'react';
     4→
     5→// ─── Brand Icon Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
     6→// Lightweight SVG icons extracted from @lobehub/icons (Mono/Color variants)
     7→// White & Black only - uses fill='currentColor' for color inheritance
     8→
     9→interface BrandIconProps {
    10→  size?: number | string;
    11→  color?: string;
    12→  className?: string;
    13→  style?: React.CSSProperties;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function createBrandIcon(paths: { d: string; fillRule?: string; clipRule?: string }[], viewBox: string, title: string) {
    17→  const Icon = React.memo(function BrandIcon({ size = '1em', color, className, style }: BrandIconProps) {
    18→    return (
    19→      <svg
    20→        fill={color || 'currentColor'}
    21→        fillRule='evenodd'
    22→        height={size}
    23→        style={{ flex: 'none', lineHeight: 1, ...style }}
    24→        viewBox={viewBox}
    25→        width={size}
    26→        xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'
    27→        className={className}
    28→      >
    29→        <title>{title}</title>
    30→        {paths.map((p, i) => (
    31→          <path
    32→            key={i}
    33→            d={p.d}
    34→            {...(p.fillRule ? { fillRule: p.fillRule } : {})}
    35→            {...(p.clipRule ? { clipRule: p.clipRule } : {})}
    36→          />
    37→        ))}
    38→      </svg>
    39→    );
    40→  });
    41→  Icon.displayName = title + 'Icon';
    42→  return Icon;
    43→}
